channel.title: summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Strange 'spacetime crystal' could turn into black hole
item.description: Physicists have mathematically described a bizarre 'spacetime crystal' that may either dissolve or collapse into a microscopic black hole after a short time.

item.title: Hidden earthquakes detected at Antarctica's Thwaites Glacier
item.description: Scientists have found hundreds of previously unnoticed seismic events beneath Antarctica, including 245 near the edge of Thwaites Glacier.

item.title: Researchers find large temperature anomaly deep within Mars
item.description: Mars exhibits a significant internal temperature difference, with its southern hemisphere potentially much hotter and partially molten compared to the north.

item.title: HEPA purifiers may improve cognitive performance in a month
item.description: Adults over 40 showed about 12% faster executive function test results after using a HEPA air purifier at home for one month.
